note: Per-day geography for the secret stats: nearest Holocene volcano (Smithsonian GVP) and nearest shoreline (Natural Earth 1:10m coastline and lakes) to any point of the day's planned track (Komoot), or to the day's start and end place when there is no track. Distances in miles; only hits within 15 mi (volcano) and 5 mi (water) are kept. Thresholds live in config.
